question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
-- Quick sanity: how many actors total have worked with Yash Chopra?
WITH yash_films AS (
    SELECT MID FROM M_Director WHERE PID = 'nm0007181'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID)) as total_actors_with_yash
FROM M_Cast mc
JOIN yash_films yf ON TRIM(mc.MID) = yf.MID

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Step 1: Get all actors who worked with Yash Chopra, and count their films with him
WITH yash_films AS (
    SELECT MID FROM M_Director WHERE PID = 'nm0007181'
),
actor_yash_count AS (
    SELECT TRIM(mc.PID) as actor_pid, p.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.MID) as films_with_yash
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN yash_films yf ON TRIM(mc.MID) = yf.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY TRIM(mc.PID), p.Name
),
-- Step 2: For each actor, find max films with any OTHER director
actor_other_max AS (
    SELECT TRIM(mc.PID) as actor_pid, MAX(dir_count) as max_with_other
    FROM (
        SELECT TRIM(mc.PID) as actor_pid, TRIM(md.PID) as director_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.MID) as dir_count
        FROM M_Cast mc
        JOIN M_Director md ON TRIM(mc.MID) = md.MID
        WHERE TRIM(md.PID) != 'nm0007181'
        GROUP BY TRIM(mc.PID), TRIM(md.PID)
    ) sub
    GROUP BY actor_pid
)
-- Step 3: Join and find actors where films_with_yash > max_with_other
SELECT ayc.actor_pid, ayc.Name, ayc.films_with_yash, COALESCE(aom.max_with_other, 0) as max_with_other
FROM actor_yash_count ayc
LEFT JOIN actor_other_max aom ON ayc.actor_pid = aom.actor_pid
WHERE ayc.films_with_yash > COALESCE(aom.max_with_other, 0)
ORDER BY ayc.films_with_yash DESC
LIMIT 30", "preview_rows": 30}
